title: 第13章 当作彩礼钱第14章 摔成太玄剑院弟子
slug: 灵气复苏我有个吞噬系统
content_zh:
“啥？成哥，你说金澜城的人来了？”
还在铁匠铺帮忙看店的丘凌风听到叶成的话，脸上一懵。
叶成是过来送前天巡逻历练杀死的那些魔兽卖出去的钱的，顺口和丘凌风说了一下金澜城来人的事情。
“对啊，来了四个人，两个男的两个女的。”
叶成点头道，
“那两个女的还是难得一见的美女，你要不要先过去看看？”
“我现在还要帮忙看店呢，走不开。”
丘凌风一摊手，说道。
张大牛现在出去采购东西了，他也不舍得让张雅出来。
毕竟自从毁容之后，张雅就很害怕别人的目光了。
“前几天那些魔兽究竟卖了多少钱啊？”
丘凌风转移话题，一副财迷相的问道。
“哦，八只遁地鼠的那些皮毛牙齿一共卖了一万二，分到你手上的有三千。”
叶成点头说道，
“你也别说成哥贪你的，这些都是按出的力算的，虽然凌风你杀了四只遁地鼠，但是只有一只遁地鼠能够卖钱，能分到三千也没坑你，其他几个学生可是一起分剩下的一千。”
说着，叶成就拿出三张千元大钞，递给了丘凌风。
这个世界的钞票面额比起前世要大许多，最大的面额足有十万。
不过一般在村民之间流通的货币，最多的还是千元的钞票。
“我知道了。”
丘凌风点了点头，欣喜的接过三千块。

这可是他这一世的人生第一桶金啊。
虽然出去巡逻十分危险，但是报酬也是十分丰厚的！
不仅有村委会每个月一万块的补贴，杀死的魔兽也是自行处理的。
一般来说，一个巡逻队队员每个月都可以收入三四万。
这在形守村当中，已经是十分高的薪酬了。
“所以你小子到底去不去高中看看？”
叶成挑了挑眉，道。
“等张叔回来再说吧。”
丘凌风耸了耸肩笑道。
“那行吧，等我把钱发完自己去高中看看好了。”
叶成耸了耸肩说道。
“嗯。”
丘凌风点了点头。
在叶成走远之后，张雅也是从丘凌风身后的桌子底下爬了出来。
content_en:
"What? Brother Cheng, you said people from Jinlan City are here?"
Qiu Lingfeng, who was still helping to look after the blacksmith shop, was confused when he heard Ye Cheng's words.
Ye Cheng came here to give away the money from the sales of the monsters he had killed during the patrol the day before yesterday. He casually told Qiu Lingfeng about the people coming from Jinlan City.
"Yes, four people came, two men and two women."
Ye Cheng nodded and said,
"Those two women are still rare beauties. Do you want to go over and take a look first?"
"I have to help look after the store now, so I can't leave."
Qiu Lingfeng spread his hands and said.
Zhang Daniu went out to buy things now, and he was reluctant to let Zhang Ya out.
After all, Zhang Ya has been afraid of other people's eyes since she was disfigured.
"How much did those Warcraft sell for a few days ago?"
Qiu Lingfeng changed the subject and asked with a money-mad look.
"Oh, the fur teeth of the eight gopher rats were sold for a total of twelve thousand, and you got three thousand."
Ye Cheng nodded and said,
"Don't say that Brother Cheng is greedy for you. These are calculated based on the power. Although Lingfeng killed four gophers, only one of them can be sold for money. If you can get three thousand, you won't be cheated. Several other students will share the remaining one thousand."
With that said, Ye Chengcheng took out three thousand-yuan bills and handed them to Qiu Lingfeng.
The denominations of banknotes in this world are much larger than those in previous lives, with the largest denomination being one hundred thousand.
However, the most common currency circulating among villagers is thousand-yuan bills.
"I understand."
Qiu Lingfeng nodded and happily took the three thousand yuan.
This is his first pot of gold in this life.
Although it is very dangerous to go out on patrol, the rewards are also very generous!
Not only is there a monthly subsidy of 10,000 yuan from the village committee, but the monsters killed are also dealt with by oneself.
Generally speaking, a patrol member can earn 30,000 to 40,000 yuan a month.
This is already a very high salary in Xingshou Village.
"So, are you going to go to high school?"
Ye Cheng raised his eyebrows and said.
"Let's wait until Uncle Zhang comes back."
Qiu Lingfeng shrugged and smiled.
"Okay, after I finish distributing the money, I can go to the high school and check it out myself."
Ye Cheng shrugged and said.
"Yeah."
Qiu Lingfeng nodded.
After Ye Cheng walked away, Zhang Ya climbed out from under the table behind Qiu Lingfeng.
